plan.title: Bug fix
plan.why: Remove a reproducible defect with a regression test and a reviewable fix.
plan.what:
## Scope

- State the failing behavior and the expected behavior.
- List the affected surfaces and the non-goals.

## Commit strategy

- Reproduce, fix, and guard with a regression test in separate green commits.

milestones.title: Fix the defect
milestones.desc:
Outcome: As a user, I want the defect removed, so that the expected behavior holds.

Scope: In scope: the failing behavior and its regression. Out of scope: unrelated defects and cleanup.

Inputs: A deterministic reproduction and the affected code path.

Slices: Reproduce, fix, guard with a regression test, then refactor and document in separate green commits.

tasks.title: Reproduce the defect
tasks.desc:
Approach: Write a failing test or a deterministic reproduction that names the expected behavior.

Touch: tests/

Inputs: The reported failing behavior and the affected code path.

Commit: One reproduction slice that fails for the expected reason.

Verify: The reproduction fails before the fix and names the defect.

Guardrails: Do not patch the fix into the reproduction commit.

tasks.title: Fix the defect
tasks.desc:
Approach: Name the root cause and make the smallest safe change.

Touch: src/

Inputs: The failing reproduction and the scouted root cause.

Commit: One minimal fix slice.

Verify: The reproduction passes and the relevant suite stays green.

Guardrails: Change only the root cause; do not refactor or rename in this slice.

tasks.title: Guard the fix with a regression test
tasks.desc:
Approach: Keep the reproduction as a permanent regression test for the defect.

Touch: tests/

Inputs: The reproduction and the fix.

Commit: One regression slice that keeps the reproduction as a permanent test.

Verify: The regression test fails without the fix.

Guardrails: Keep the test deterministic and offline.

tasks.title: Refactor the touched code
tasks.desc:
Approach: Leave the fix area cleaner without changing behavior.

Touch: src/, tests/

Inputs: A green fix and its regression test.

Commit: One refactor slice with no behavior change.

Verify: The full test suite passes.

Guardrails: Stop when the tests cannot prove the behavior is unchanged.

tasks.title: Update the documentation
tasks.desc:
Approach: Record the corrected behavior where users will look.

Touch: docs/

Inputs: The final fix and its verification commands.

Commit: One documentation slice.

Verify: Links and examples resolve against the shipped behavior.

Guardrails: Do not document a fix the change did not ship.
